The record is source-bound as an exact-day reporting event; later cataloging notes star-like characteristics, so no anomalous-origin promotion is allowed.

rows.reported_summary: Project Blue Book chronology records a Walker AFB observation on 16 June 1952 by USAF maintenance specialist S/Sgt. Sparks, who reported a formation of multiple grayish disc-like objects. R4.1 records only the exact-day federal case lineage.

Project Blue Book catalogs preserve a Walker AFB event on 29 July 1952 in which four weather observers, including the base weather officer, reported high-speed disc-like objects through a theodolite. R4.1 counts the site-date once.
